en: Phew! We've dug and dug at this heap all week, and it won't budge... Hang on. Is one of your Pokémon good at Rock Smash?
It is? Then let's all have a go at once! Ready... smash!
We did it! The way through to the next floor is open at last. That's the end of the job. I'll ring the cart man and head home!
No? Ah well. We'll keep at it with our picks, then...
Chip, chip, chip! Chip, chip, chip! This heap is tougher than it looks!
A heap of broken rock fills the way.
You there! Fancy a ride in the mining cart?
Whenever you like, just come and ask me.
Hop in and hold on tight!
